(+)-Thujan-3-ol dehydrogenase
(
EC
1.1.1.323
,
d-3-thujanol dehydrogenase
,
TDH
) is an
enzyme
with
systematic name
(+)-thujan-3-ol:NAD(P)
+
oxidoreductase
.
[
1
]
This enzyme
catalyses
the following
chemical reaction
(+)-thujan-3-ol + NAD(P)
+
⇌
{\displaystyle \rightleftharpoons }
(+)-thujan-3-one + NAD(P)H + H
+
This enzyme is isolated from the plant
Tanacetum vulgare
.
